newsitem.title: USA: U.S. offers to work with Pakistan's Sharif.
newsitem.headline: U.S. offers to work with Pakistan's Sharif.

text.p: The United States on Tuesday congratulated Nawaz Sharif on his apparent victory in Pakistan's elections and said it hoped to work "cooperatively" with him if he formed a government.
"We certainly congratulate Mr. Nawaz Sharif upon his apparent victory," State Department spokesman Nicholas Burns said.
"And should he indeed form the next government of Pakistan, the United States government will work with him, cooperatively to strengthen our relationship with Pakistan," Burns told a news briefing.

In Pakistan, ousted prime minister Benazir Bhutto on Tuesday refused to accept defeat in Monday's elections, but offered to cooperate with Sharif, leader of the Pakistan Moslem League, for political stability.
Burns said international observers had not reported any significant electoral irregularities.
